figures.finding: A screenwriter can apply in their own name for the Ministry's Screenplay and Dialogue Writing support for a feature screenplay, one project a year; after two awards a writer may apply again only once one of the funded scripts has been filmed.

value.reapplyCondition: after two awards, one funded script must have been filmed
